text.p: Commodore Applied Technologies Inc said Tuesday that its chairman and chief executive officer, Paul Hanneson, has been named to the additional post of president.
A spokeswoman for the company said Hannesson replaces as president Edwin Harper, who will continue to be vice chairman of the board and a consultant to the company.

The company said it also named Michael Fullwood as chief financial officer. Fullwood, who was formerly executive vice president and chief financial officer of Witco Corp, will also have the additional positions of senior vice president, administrative officer, general counsel and secretary for all Commodore companies.
Fullwood replaces William Ingram, a senior executive who previously held the responsibilities but not the title of chief financial officer, the spokeswoman said.
